mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile because it connected water recovery to the small molecules made by bacteria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was straightforward and predictable, though it helped build the protected wall.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the bacteria to produce gas as well as small fatty acids from fibre.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the parts' purposes, although the final two combinations were the only ones offered.

continue.text: I might continue to see how more body systems connect, but the mostly straightforward, hinted combinations were not a strong hook by themselves.
